clue.text: Eccentric joined in as an adventurous archaeologist

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, telling us the letters of the next four words are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: An oddball has signed up for an expedition as a daring dig leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Eccentric' looks like a noun naming a person, but it is the anagram signal over JOINED IN AS AN.
explanation.definitionFit: The film hero of Raiders of the Lost Ark is a fictional professor who goes on perilous digs.

clue.text: So-called Greek maiden is introducing radio broadcast

indicators.note: introducing means the first piece is placed in front, leading in what follows
broadcast suggests scattering seed widely, so the letters of radio are scattered and rearranged

explanation.surface: A Greek girl is presenting a radio programme.
explanation.walkthrough: 'So-called' marks a girl's name of Greek origin rather than a common noun; 'broadcast' scrambles the radio letters.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female given name from Greek, meaning gift of Isis.

clue.text: Duke agreed to differ and drop in rank

indicators.note: to differ means the letters of agreed are made different, rearranged into another order

explanation.surface: A nobleman agrees to disagree and is demoted.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface plays 'agreed' against 'to differ', which is really the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: To demote someone is to lower their standing or status.

clue.text: Cover article after woman found worm

indicators.note: after means the following pieces come behind the woman's name

parts.note: Anne is a woman's name
a lid is a cover
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A woman discovers a worm while covering up an item.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue gives the cover and article first; 'after' puts them behind the woman's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a segmented creature of the phylum including earthworms and leeches.

clue.text: Flooded area was the last thing Noah needed

indicators.note: the last thing of a word is its final letter, here the end of Noah

explanation.surface: A flooded region was the very last thing the ark-builder wanted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the last thing Noah needed' sounds like more water, but it means the final letter of Noah, H.
explanation.definitionFit: Something swamped is covered with water.

clue.text: Far from modern, like some parachutes not opening

indicators.note: not opening means the first letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a golden parachute is a lavish payoff for a departing executive

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned, like a parachute that fails to open.
explanation.walkthrough: Remove the first letter of GOLDEN. A golden parachute is a generous severance deal, not a canopy that opens.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a literary word for belonging to times long past.

clue.text: Stop trading, accordingly, without business qualification

indicators.note: without is used in its old sense of outside, so one piece surrounds the other

parts.note: ergo is Latin for therefore, so accordingly
an MBA is a Master of Business Administration degree

explanation.surface: Ceasing to do business as a result of having no management degree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking: the conjunction goes round the degree.
explanation.definitionFit: An official ban on commerce with a country halts trade.

Maid that is holding a sandwich for former tennis champion

clue.text: Keep out, as part of trade barrier

indicators.note: part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Exclude, as a trade restriction does.
explanation.definitionFit: To bar someone is to exclude or prohibit them from entry.

clue.text: Rich person with everything gets extra

parts.note: a nob is slang for a wealthy or upper-class person
all means everything

explanation.surface: A wealthy man who has it all gets something more.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a no-ball is an illegal delivery, and the run it gives the batting side is one of the extras.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket an illegal delivery awards a run counted among the sundries.

clue.text: Safety feature on flight, giving help to flier

parts.note: to give a hand is to help
a rail is a wading bird, so a flier

explanation.surface: A banister on an aircraft helps a nervous passenger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flight' is a flight of stairs, not an air journey; a rail is a marsh bird.
explanation.definitionFit: A banister is gripped for support on a staircase.

clue.text: What can be seen in Paul and George, but not John and Ringo?

definitions.text: What can be seen in Paul and George, but not John and Ringo?

parts.words: What can be seen in Paul and George, but not John and Ringo?
parts.note: the Beatles' names are read as words: Paul and George contain glided vowel sounds spelt with two vowels, John and Ringo only pure vowels

explanation.surface: A Beatles quiz question about what two band members share.
explanation.walkthrough: The names are taken as words to be sounded, not as people: the vowel glides in Paul and George are the point.
explanation.definitionFit: These are gliding speech sounds combining two vowels in one syllable, as in the au of Paul.

clue.text: This bed is mine

definitions.meaning: a coal mine or quarry is also a ...

explanation.walkthrough: 'This' is only a link; both senses are plain nouns.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang uses the word for a bed, and it also names a colliery.

clue.text: State of Shakespeare or another playwright

parts.note: Tennessee is a US state
Shakespeare's first name is William, so of Shakespeare is William's

explanation.surface: The status of the Bard compared with some other dramatist.
explanation.walkthrough: 'of Shakespeare' gives his first name in the possessive. The theme is famous people named after US states.
explanation.definitionFit: The American author of A Streetcar Named Desire was a dramatist.

clue.text: President joining actor manager and author

parts.note: George Washington was the first US president
Sir Henry Irving was a famous Victorian actor-manager

explanation.surface: A head of state teams up with a theatre impresario and a writer.
explanation.walkthrough: Henry Irving ran London's Lyceum Theatre as actor and manager. The writer took both surnames.
explanation.definitionFit: The American wrote Rip Van Winkle and The Legend of Sleepy Hollow.

clue.text: Having certain arrangement of members to get Kipling's work into a book circle

indicators.note: into means the novel's title goes inside the following letters

parts.note: Kim is a novel by Rudyard Kipling
O is shaped like a circle

explanation.surface: Posture of a reader cramming Kipling into a book club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'members' means limbs: arms bent with hands on hips.
explanation.definitionFit: Standing with hands on hips and elbows out is a particular pose of the arms.

clue.text: Greeted as sacred, having renounced West

indicators.note: having renounced means giving something up, so a letter is dropped

parts.note: hallowed means holy or sacred

explanation.surface: Something hailed as holy after turning its back on the West.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greeted as sacred' reads as one phrase, but the definition is only 'Greeted'.
explanation.definitionFit: To shout a hunting call or hello at someone is to hail them.

clue.text: Main point of Americans serving time

parts.note: GIs are American soldiers in service

explanation.surface: The key fact about US soldiers doing their tour of duty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serving' means serving in the forces.
explanation.definitionFit: The essence or substance of something is its core idea.

clue.text: In European country British leader found sweet jazzwoman

parts.note: Georgia is a country on the edge of Europe in the Caucasus
Gordon Brown was a British prime minister

explanation.surface: A UK politician abroad meets a charming jazz singer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sweet Georgia Brown' is a jazz standard about a girl of that name.
explanation.definitionFit: The title character of the jazz song Sweet Georgia Brown is a woman.

clue.text: After cooking, they use the rest at night

indicators.note: after cooking means the ingredients they and use are mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: Once dinner is made, people use the remaining time for sleep.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the rest' looks like the remainder, but it means repose.
explanation.definitionFit: It is informal for sleep, the closing of the eyes.

clue.text: See 15
Girl entering barn on fire, ignoring all the odds

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters are skipped and the even ones kept from barn on fire

explanation.surface: A girl going into a burning barn, against all the odds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'against the odds' is a stock phrase; here 'the odds' are odd letters.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a female given name.

clue.text: Arab's second car

parts.note: Audi is a German car make

explanation.surface: An Arab's backup vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is read as 'is', linking definition and wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: A person from Saudi Arabia is one kind of Arab.

clue.text: Departing from the book, as movie

definitions.meaning: a mass departure of people is the noun for leaving
the second book of the Bible

explanation.walkthrough: 'from' and 'as' are links between three definitions.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means a mass departure, names the second Bible book about leaving Egypt, and a 1960 film.

clue.text: See 19 Down
Short of subscriptions? Such cheques are worthless

definitions.meaning: lacking subscriptions in the old sense of signatures written underneath
a cheque nobody has put a name to cannot be cashed

explanation.walkthrough: 'subscriptions' looks like magazine orders, but a subscription is literally a signature.
explanation.definitionFit: Without a signature, a document is unendorsed and a cheque is invalid.

clue.text: Having crashed at speed, I have means for quick fix

indicators.note: crashed means the letters of at speed I have are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: A driver who crashed at speed has something for a quick repair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Having' is a link; 'crashed' rearranges AT SPEED I HAVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sticky strip is used for fast makeshift repairs.
